series: The CFO Week (Friday bulletin, issue 2, calendar theme)
service: Tax, CFO and cash, e-invoicing, audit and risk

lines.say: Two deadlines on Monday, and a holiday midweek. Here's your finance week.

scenes.head: E-invoicing guidelines: *version 2.1*
scenes.sub: UAE Ministry of Finance, Electronic Invoicing Guidelines V2.1, 25 Nov 2026. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF. Valorin is not an ASP.

lines.say: Last week, the Ministry of Finance published e-invoicing guidelines, version two point one.

scenes.head: File by *Monday 30 Nov*
scenes.sub: FTA announcements: final deadline for filing VAT returns, 30 Nov 2026. Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Arts. 48 and 53: nine months from the end of the tax period, unless the FTA sets another date.

lines.say: Do: file your VAT return by Monday, the thirtieth of November.
Tax period ended the twenty-eighth of February? Your corporate tax return points to the same day.
lines.cap: Tax period ended *28 Feb*? Corporate tax points to *30 Nov* too.

scenes.head: Don't pay *on the holiday*
scenes.sub: u.ae lists National Day as 2 and 3 December. Confirm against the official 2026 announcement.

lines.say: Avoid: paying on the National Day holiday, the second and third of December.
Move payroll earlier, and check your bank's cut-off times.

scenes.head: Dates to *ring*
scenes.sub: Mon 30 Nov: VAT returns, final deadline (FTA) · Mon 30 Nov: corporate tax, periods ended 28 Feb 2026 · Wed 2 – Thu 3 Dec: National Day holiday (u.ae; confirm against the official 2026 announcement) · Tue 8 – Wed 9 Dec: US Federal Reserve meeting · Tue 15 Dec: Excise returns, final deadline (FTA)

lines.say: Coming up: VAT returns on Monday, then the holiday.
The Fed meets on the eighth and ninth of December.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF. Valorin is not an ASP. The Fed date is a calendar fact, not a rate forecast.
